source_instruction: i am looking for stainless steel hair cutting scissors of 7 inch size.
query: I stopped by the community garden on my walk home yesterday, and the tomato plants the elementary school kids put in back in May are absolutely bursting with fruit right now. A couple of the kids were there with their teacher, pulling weeds and tying the sprawling vines to the wooden stakes they hammered in themselves, and they were so proud to show off the tiny green cherry tomatoes already starting to plump up under the fuzzy leaves. One of them even pressed a crumpled, crayon-drawn picture of a giant red tomato into my palm, all stick-figure vines and yellow sun scribbled in the corner, and it’s already taped to my fridge right next to the grocery list I scribbled last week. I’ve heard stainless steel hair cutting tools work really well for home trims, that the right size for that use is a seven, that there’s a wrong version of that tool that’s easy to mix up, that it doesn’t make sense to spend too much on one, that the price point that makes sense is whatever lines up with a decent basic option that holds up to regular use.

placements: 7 (other units/contexts, e.g. 7 inch hair cutting tool size misattributed to non-length measurement, or 7 as a model number instead of 7 inch length)
